doc.heading: Project Funding Agreement
doc.preamble: Whereas the first party provides funding to support small enterprises, and the second party wishes to obtain such funding, both parties have agreed as follows:
doc.clause1: The first party shall disburse the amount stated above to the second party's account within ten working days of signature.
doc.clause2: The second party shall use the funding exclusively for the stated project and submit performance reports every three months.
doc.clause3: The first party may suspend disbursement or demand repayment if the funding is used for other purposes.
doc.clause4: This agreement is governed by the laws of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and the competent courts shall settle any dispute.
